mentions.name: Basil
mentions.description: Privacy-first AI executive assistant and note taker that runs entirely on-device, with transcription and summarization handled locally so nothing is shared with model providers. The roadmap focuses on making output actually useful: recurring workflows, follow-ups, personalized summaries shaped to how someone runs their day, and reliable agent automation instead of one-off chat, plus work around iOS background-processing limitations.
mentions.problem: Raw transcription output isn't actually useful on its own; the product aims to deliver actionable recurring workflows, follow-ups, and personalized summaries, while contending with iOS limitations on background work.
mentions.audience: Business professionals who want an AI assistant/note taker that fits how they run their day.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Basil (https://basilai.app), a privacy-first AI executive assistant / note taker. Everything is on-device: transcription, summarization, etc. So nothing is shared with any model provider.
